decisions.reason: This core-adjacent track spotlight has had its own page for two consecutive years, which suggests results that meet aspirations in a growing industry, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The ceiling luminaire has been featured prominently for two years and fits the established range, which points to satisfactory performance that management has no reason to revisit.
The flexible spotlight is newly launched with its own page and lies close to the core offer, and the slack from industry growth lets the firm carry it while its results are still uncertain.
The multi-outlet canopy complements the modular system strategy and gets dedicated presentation, so absent evidence of a shortfall the firm keeps it.
The low-voltage canopy extends the modular system and is still early in its life, and the firm's slack supports keeping it while it builds results.
The round glass track luminaires receive only a mention, which hints at weaker priority, but they fit the track range closely and there is no clear sign they fall short of aspirations.
